optional_continuation_sources: a registered Pratt led/postfix parselet that accepts the current left node and next token
an owner-specific suffix admitted by the current grammar state
forbidden_heuristics: token text not present in the registered parser tables

statement_boundary_algorithm.multiple_semicolon_policy: the first semicolon closes the statement; a following semicolon has no empty-statement owner and is rejected
statement_boundary_algorithm.closing_delimiter_policy: a closing delimiter does not satisfy StatementBoundary; BlockFinalItem or the owning grammar production must admit the unterminated final form

STATEMENT_MATCH.direct_expression_result: discarded after ordinary ExprStmt responsibility checking

VALUE_MATCH.ordinary_return: parsed for deterministic AT_MATCH_ARM_RETURN_IS_NOT_RESULT checking, never a local arm result

ordered_entry_choice.law: the brace immediately after an arm FAT_ARROW belongs to the arm body; a closure value in this position must be parenthesized

ordered_entry_choice.lookahead: return, throw, break, continue, or yield introducer
ordered_entry_choice.law: parse one ControlTransfer; the checker applies the mode-specific admission law

braced_body_by_mode.VALUE_MATCH: local value block; every normal path produces its result through ret
braced_body_by_mode.CLAUSE_FUNCTION: function-clause block; direct result and control-transfer laws follow the enclosing named function

direct_expression_stop_candidates: the exact match close delimiter at owner_delimiter_depth
physical newline followed by a successful transactional MatchHead GuardClause? FAT_ARROW probe
match_arm_body_algorithm.required_rhs_rule: a prefix or infix construct requiring a child always continues across newline and cannot yield an arm separator
match_arm_body_algorithm.open_range_rule: a completed terminal open-range expression such as a.. may stop at newline when the transactional next-arm probe succeeds
match_arm_body_algorithm.evaluation_or_type_effect: none; this is a parse partition only

transactional_next_arm_probe.input: the next significant token after newline at owner_delimiter_depth
transactional_next_arm_probe.parse: MatchHead GuardClause? FAT_ARROW under the same feature profile and MatchArmContext
transactional_next_arm_probe.success: the probe reaches the arm FAT_ARROW at owner_delimiter_depth
transactional_next_arm_probe.failure: consume zero tokens and emit zero diagnostics from the probe

match_arm_separator_algorithm.semicolon_policy: semicolon is not a match-arm separator
match_arm_separator_algorithm.blank_line_policy: one or more physical line breaks form one contextual separator
match_arm_separator_algorithm.comment_policy: comments remain exact trivia; a newline inside comment trivia participates in the same probe
match_arm_separator_algorithm.trailing_separator_policy: one comma or one contextual newline may precede the close delimiter; no empty arm is created

diagnostic_authority_fence: reason codes are exact parser oracles; final primary diagnostic registry binding remains in IR-FE-P1-035
